text:
Assistant B is better overall. It corrects the grammatical errors while maintaining consistent past-tense narration, which fixes the original’s tense inconsistencies. It also improves the repetitive “but…but” construction with “although.” Assistant A corrects many errors but leaves the first sentence in the present tense while the rest is in the past, creating a tense mismatch. B has a minor punctuation issue with the comma after “Can you?”, but its grammar and consistency are stronger.

[[B]]
